# Asset provenance

All three geometric emblems were authored specifically for this LOBBOT exploration in `generate-assets.py`. Wordmarks are outlined from the accompanying openly licensed fonts. The SVG comparison board was authored in `create-brand-board.py`; its PNG is a raster rendering of that exact SVG using Sharp. No stock photographs or AI-generated raster artwork are used.

Original font files and SIL Open Font License texts come from the official Google Fonts repository. The accompanying WOFF2 files were converted from those TTF sources with FontTools and Brotli. See `fonts/*-OFL.txt` and the links in `brand-guidelines.md`.

The process graphic is runtime geometry controlled by the illustrative sequence in `app.js`, not a measured model result. Browser screenshots used for verification are development evidence and are not included in the brand kit.
